scope_notes: No raw messages, hidden reasoning, provider error text, images, credentials or gold are exported.
Python JSONL records OCR/probe requests; Pi requests are reconciled from durable checkpoints and results.
A started intent without a terminal row does not prove provider acceptance or billing; totals remain unknown when usage is missing.
Known usage subtotals exclude missing fields and must not be presented as full-run totals.
Cache token counts are separate fields and are not added again to input_tokens.
Journal tool attempts are not HTTP requests or guaranteed Core mutations; pending outcomes and receipt reuse are explicit.
Elapsed job timestamps include interruption/downtime and are not proof of uninterrupted 900-second execution.
This report scores no chemistry answers and performs no API/model calls.

One checkpoint is unreadable by the production decoder; no recovery or alteration attempted. Observable provider rows also come from actual run/job results and the OCR ledger. Request counts are observed counts; absence of additional requests in the invalid checkpoint is unverified.
